name: novita_ai
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM chat, completions, embeddings and rerank on Novita AI
long_description: Bring a Novita AI API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key reads the account balance (GET /openapi/v1/billing/balance/detail), which runs no model and costs nothing. A Sprite can then list and read models, run chat and text completions (including SSE streaming), create embeddings and rerank documents through the OpenAI-compatible API under /openai/v1, and read the balance. Every completion, embedding and rerank request is billed to your Novita AI balance per token. Batches and files, image, audio and video generation, GPU instances, serverless GPU endpoints, API key policies and bill listings are not forwarded.

presentation.tagline: Run Novita AI's OpenAI-compatible LLMs from a Sprite without putting your API key on it.
presentation.setup: Sign in at novita.ai, open Settings → Key Management and create an API key (it starts with `sk_`). The full key is shown only once. Model access and IP restrictions set on the key still apply.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key reads `GET /openapi/v1/billing/balance/detail`, which runs no model and costs nothing. Chat completions, text completions, embeddings and rerank are billed per token against your Novita AI balance at each model's price on novita.ai/pricing. `GET /openai/v1/models` returns chat models' prices per million tokens in 1/10000 USD; embedding and rerank models are not in that list. Listing and reading models and reading the balance are free.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `GET /openai/v1/models`, `GET /openai/v1/models/:owner/:model`, `POST /openai/v1/chat/completions`, `POST /openai/v1/completions`, `POST /openai/v1/embeddings`, `POST /openai/v1/rerank` and `GET /openapi/v1/billing/balance/detail` are forwarded, so a Sprite can read the account balance. Batches and files, image, audio and video generation, GPU instances and serverless endpoints, API key policies and bill listings are not.

usage_notes: Point an OpenAI SDK at the gateway's `/openai/v1` base; model ids look like `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`.
Errors are `{"code": 401, "reason": "FAILED_TO_AUTH", "message": "...", "metadata": {}}`. A wrong key is 401; a 403 means a valid key that lacks balance, model access or identity verification.
Non-streaming generations that run longer than 120 seconds hit the gateway's response deadline; use `stream: true` for long outputs.
